associations.title: Répliquer les rangs appris et points restants au propriétaire
associations.finding: Simulation snapshot clones ranks/level/current resource and adds max_mana;team visibility projection retains own actor. Server sends atomic snapshot to accepted player. Remaining points are computed client-side as level-sum(ranks),not a separate replicated counter.
associations.remaining: Qualify all rank schemes,privacy,malformed states and multiclient/reconnect ordering;source links do not qualify original packet format.

associations.remaining: Qualify every champion,disabled/unavailable states,input transitions,layout/animation and actual visual output.

associations.title: Relier les raccourcis d’apprentissage aux commandes serveur
associations.finding: Ordered physical key handler captures Ctrl at keydown for Q/W/E/R,ignores repeat and keeps first slot intent. Main constructs Learn and sends via connection.send_action;server owns actor and revalidates. This is local fixed binding,not recovered native input loop.
associations.remaining: Qualify rebinds,layouts,focus/UI capture,repeat/reconnect and end-to-end server refusal;native shortcut authority remains open.

associations.title: Afficher le motif d’un apprentissage refusé
associations.finding: Bounded matching-session gameplay rejection is stored by Connection.report;main inserts reason into the F3 debug label. Connected default hides this label,and next successful snapshot clears rejection. Logging/conditional debug text do not prove a normal persistent learning-error notification.
associations.remaining: Identify or implement ordinary visible learning refusal UI,localized cause,command association,lifetime and accessibility;qualify after fast next-state updates.

associations.title: Restaurer les rangs et ressources dans le HUD après reconnexion
associations.finding: SessionClient rejects state missing own player and gates state release on bootstrap;main commits snapshot before presented/ready. Learning and bars consume current snapshot,with Mana-only rendering. Resume does not reconstruct ranks locally.
associations.remaining: Qualify live reconnect across every resource/rank type and old epoch/stale frames;own-state source path is not full native HUD restoration.
